body.p: by packet , on the orchestrator's acceptance of P5. SXML_IR_MAP_REQUIRES_NODES in sxml_ir_map_flag: lowering sets it on the MAP of E1/E2 and of //; the evaluator raises XPTY0019 (XPath 4.0, section 4.6.3) for an input item that is not a generic node. The text form does not print the flag, so the golden dumps of are unchanged; the verifier accepts it.
